Anxiety: Sometimes I wonder if I'm going to do the right thing, like I'm watching a movie of my life choices and hoping the ending isn't bad.
My chest feels tight, like there's a fist wrapped around my heart, and I can't shake that knot of panic even when everything is calm.
I start overthinking conversations, replaying what was said, imagining worst-case scenarios, long after the moment has passed.
There's this constant, low hum of worry underneath everything, like a background static that I can't turn off.
I feel like I'm walking on eggshells, waiting for something to snap, something terrifying to happen, even though I can't pinpoint what.
I get this weird dizziness, like the room is spinning but I know it's just my anxiety playing tricks on me.
I find myself checking my phone compulsively, needing reassurance that everything is okay, even when I know there's nothing urgent.
My hands shake sometimes, especially when I'm trying to do something simple, like writing an email or holding a cup of coffee.
I feel like I'm waiting for the other shoe to drop, like there's always something just around the corner that will make everything worse.
I can't breathe properly sometimes, like I'm trapped in a thick fog, and every inhale feels like it's stealing the air right out of me.
